newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia UEM to issue 9-mth results.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia UEM to issue 9-mth results.

text.p: Malaysian construction company United Engineers (Malaysia) Bhd (UEM) said it will be releasing its results for the nine months to September 30, 1996, some time this week.
A spokeswoman for UEM declined to say exactly when the result would be issued, but another source within the company said it would be released later on Thursday.

UEM is involved in some of the largest infrastructure development projects in Malaysia, such as the new Kuala Lumpur International Airport and the building of the stadium that will house the 1998 Commonwealth Games.

UEM reported a net profit of 182.46 million ringgit for the nine months to September 30, 1995, or 33.5 cents per share. It achieved this on turnover of 1.19 billion ringgit. ($1 = 2.5 ringgit) -- Kuala Lumpur newsroom (603-230 8911)
